title: EggStreme Malware Variant Goes Silent to Evade Security Tools in Government Attacks
content_md: The suspected Chinese advanced persistent threat (APT) group behind the sophisticated EggStreme malware has rebuilt its toolkit as it continues to target government organizations in the Philippines.
